name: CreateCompanyLead
label: Create Company Lead
description: Creates a company-associated lead in SAP Cloud for Customer.

fields.name: ClientId
fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: The Client ID from SAP C4C App Management.

fields.name: ClientSecret
fields.label: Client Secret
fields.description: The Client Secret from SAP C4C App Management.

fields.name: Subdomain
fields.label: Subdomain
fields.description: Your SAP C4C subdomain (e.g., 'mycompany' in mycompany.crm.ondemand.com).

fields.name: LeadData
fields.label: Lead Data
fields.description: The new lead data in JSON format (e.g., {"AccountID": "ACC00000001", "Status": "New"}).

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The response from the C4C server after creating the lead.
